Production IP/netlink socket creation (198), duplication and final close use executing workers and actual Files.
Socket-owned control gates replace the independent VFS publication gate; packet observers carry no final-close callback.

still_owner: bind/connect/listen/accept dispatch and blocking/policy-aware network paths
constraints: No blanket unsafe Send/Sync, new coordinator/service thread, polling bus, spin loop, quota or guest-race errno.
Ordinary native TCP bytes keep the direct weak endpoint path; mutable authority/policy captures remain joined.
No full application performance inference; physical iPad tests skipped per owner.

linux_reference.identity: Exact fixture ELF SHA-256 verified; native Linux reference is in the local 6-vCPU ARM64 CI machine, not Trames.

validation.unchanged_acceptance: CPU/memory/graphics/interpreter scheduling acceptance reused; only affected tests and failed items rerun.

method: Four independent processes, fixed work/checksums. Three unprofiled counterbalanced runs; longest-child loop medians. Separate profiled samples include startup/teardown and nonblocking retries; counters are not CPU utilization or timings.
